name: Convert a legacy HTML page with inline styles, a form and an iframe
query: Here is the About page from our old static site (HTML with inline styles, a newsletter form and an embedded map iframe). Turn it into blocks for the new WordPress site and tell me what did not convert.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wp-html-to-blocks; state that site migration concerns (stylesheet rewriting, the form's backend, assets) are out of scope and only the page content is converted
Step 2: Run the script on the HTML as given, before editing anything, and read the report

Step 3: Read Design mapped and Design dropped: custom colours and font sizes land as style.color and style.typography values; a text-align on a div is dropped with the reason and moved onto the text blocks
Step 4: Read Fallbacks: the form and the iframe are core/html; explain the choice for each (keep as Custom HTML, replace with a plugin form block, or replace the iframe with an embeddable URL)
Step 5: Make the agreed edits to the HTML (not to the block markup) and re-run until the only fallbacks are the chosen ones
Step 6: Insert as a draft and report the dropped declarations and the remaining Custom HTML blocks to the user
success_criteria: The script is run on the original HTML first; nothing is silently dropped
Each core/html fallback is named with its source element and a decision
Dropped design is listed with the script's reason, not hidden
Fixes are made in the source HTML and re-validated; block JSON is never edited by hand
The whole page is not wrapped in a single core/html
The fixture fixtures/legacy-page in the skill shows the expected report shape: 12 blocks, 2 fallbacks, 2 dropped declarations
